currentUserGoal: Fix desktop board panning after the user reported that the panning/move keyboard controls no longer worked.
changesMade: Confirmed desktop keyboard panning still worked on a full 1280x720 large-field layout after focus, but the key handler was unnecessarily tied to World Map visibility.
Changed the desktop key handler to pan whenever the board has pan overflow instead of requiring shouldShowWorldMap().
Added WASD aliases alongside the existing arrow keys for the move controls.
Kept mobile touch pan controls on the existing panBoardInDirection path and preserved the existing mobile guard for keyboard panning.

Mobile visual check at 390x844 with fieldShape=rect1200: the existing right-arrow pan control still moved the board; console warning/error log was empty.

knownIssues: Desktop mouse-drag panning remains intentionally separate from this hotfix; the user clarified the issue was the move keyboard controls.
The handler name is still handleWorldMapKeyDown even though it now handles board panning more generally.
nextRecommendedSteps: Deploy and sync this hotfix to keep production and the Mac mini aligned.
Consider renaming handleWorldMapKeyDown to handleBoardPanKeyDown in a future cleanup if touching this area again.
doNotRevert: Keep desktop keyboard panning based on board pan overflow, not World Map visibility.
Keep the WASD aliases unless they conflict with a future text-entry surface.
